codeReview.summary: Implementation of ConfigMap generator for OpenCompass configuration is complete and correct. Generates valid MMEngine Python config files with model config (OpenAI/Anthropic/DashScope), dataset config, inferencer settings. ConfigMap is created with correct labels matching Job. 22 test cases provide comprehensive coverage.

summary: Feature implementation passes review. Code quality is high with comprehensive test coverage (22 test cases), proper error handling for all required fields, correct validation contract compliance (VAL-K8S-009, VAL-K8S-010). Worker correctly reused existing k8s.Labels() function from labels.go package. Generated configs include all required model fields (type, path, max_seq_len, max_out_len, batch_size, run_cfg), proper API key environment variable references, and correct inferencer settings (OpenICLInferencer with batch_size).
